title: Append and query contract states through the public plan API
preconditions: Use isolated handoff contracts between provider and consumer; record their initial event heads through public queries. Public lifecycle authoring must be discoverable in plan help.

steps.action: Inspect plan help/spec for the supported contract-state operation.
steps.expected_result: An operation accepts contract identity, new state, event identity and every current parent head.

steps.action: Using separate valid lifecycle fixtures, append proposed, accepted, fulfilled, violated and waived through that public operation; query work-events --kind contract after each mutation.
steps.expected_result: Each state is returned as an append-only event with its submitted parent heads; prior events remain visible.

expected_result: All five contract states are publicly authorable and queryable without direct metadata edits.
